glass: tall highball glass (about 300 ml), three ice cubes
version: v1.1 (round 4, 2026-10-02; wording only, numbers unchanged from v1): a Tequila Highball on the Codex's root build (Whisky Highball, p. 199: spirit, three cubes, a three-second stir, cold seltzer, one stir; the Codex leaves out the lemon wedge, p. 199) with blanco tequila in place of whisky (p. 208: seltzer turns blanco tequila from earthy and vegetal to citrusy). Fortaleza Blanco (the standard one, not the Still Strength; 40% unsourced, swept 38-46%) recommended (Oxford SAUZA pdf 1742-1743: his tequila, made with a tahona); substitute style: a blanco tequila made with a tahona. 2:5 spirit to seltzer (the Codex's ratio for more assertive whiskies, p. 199, carried to tequila as my call). No lime, no sugar. Spark: one small oregano sprig, pinched and laid on the ice (Flavor Matrix pdf 306: tequila shares carvacrol, 'caraway, spice, thyme', with papaya; oregano carries it too), a scent the tequila already shares, so it brings forward something already there.
